stagesSection.title: What happens after you join HostMetric
stagesSection.description: A structured commercial workflow designed to continuously improve how your property is positioned, priced, managed and experienced by guests.

stages.title: Property & Market Audit
stages.text: We assess the property, location, capacity, amenities, positioning, target guest profile and existing commercial setup.

stages.title: Historical Performance Analysis
stages.text: Existing booking and performance data is examined to establish a measurable baseline before optimization begins.

stages.title: Competitive Set Modelling
stages.text: We build a relevant competitive set using comparable accommodation with similar location, capacity, amenities and positioning.

stages.title: Listing Architecture
stages.text: The commercial presentation of the property is structured to make its strongest selling points immediately clear to potential guests.

stages.title: Conversion Optimization
stages.text: Listings are refined around clarity, user behaviour and booking intent so traffic has a stronger opportunity to convert into reservations.

stages.title: Multi-Channel Distribution
stages.text: The property is positioned across supported booking and travel channels to expand reach while maintaining one coordinated commercial strategy.

stages.title: Calendar & Availability Sync
stages.text: Reservations, availability and calendar changes are coordinated across connected channels to maintain accurate inventory.

stages.title: Demand Intelligence
stages.text: Demand signals are continuously evaluated before pricing decisions are made.

stages.title: Revenue Management Engine
stages.text: Rate and occupancy are evaluated together using measurable hospitality performance indicators rather than static nightly pricing.

stages.title: Dynamic Pricing & Inventory
stages.text: Pricing and inventory strategy evolves as demand, remaining availability, booking pace and time until arrival change.

stages.title: Reservation Management
stages.text: Bookings are monitored as part of one workflow from reservation confirmation through arrival and departure.

stages.title: Human Guest Communication
stages.text: Trained team members manage guest conversations with fast, natural and situation-specific communication instead of relying only on automated templates.

stages.title: Review & Reputation Intelligence
stages.text: Guest feedback is treated as operational information that can reveal recurring strengths, weaknesses and opportunities for improvement.

stages.title: Owner Performance Reporting
stages.text: Property performance is translated into understandable information so owners can see what is changing and why.

stages.title: Growth & Rebooking Strategy
stages.text: The commercial strategy extends beyond the first reservation by identifying opportunities to strengthen repeat demand and direct relationships.

stages.title: Kontinuirana optimizacija
stages.text: The process does not finish after setup. Performance, pricing, listings, reviews and market conditions continuously feed the next optimization cycle.

propertySection.title: Upravljanje i razvoj vaše nekretnine
propertySection.description: Kako HostMetric upravlja distribucijom, rezervacijama, cenama, komunikacijom sa gostima i kontinuiranim unapređenjem performansi vaše nekretnine.

questions.question: Šta treba da uradim da bih počeo da sarađujem sa HostMetric-om?
questions.answer: Početak je jednostavan. Recite nam nešto o svojoj nekretnini i trenutnom načinu upravljanja, a naš tim će pregledati pozicioniranje, cene, dostupnost i distribuciju. Zatim ćemo pripremiti nekretninu za profesionalno upravljanje i napraviti strategiju prilagođenu njenim karakteristikama i vašim ciljevima.

questions.question: Kako HostMetric pomaže da povećam broj rezervacija?
questions.answer: HostMetric kombinuje optimizovanu prezentaciju nekretnine, stratešku distribuciju, pametno određivanje cena i kontinuirano praćenje performansi. Umesto da oglas posmatramo kao nešto statično, stalno analiziramo rezultate i prilagođavamo strategiju kada uočimo mogućnosti za poboljšanje.

questions.question: Mogu li i dalje da prihvatam sopstvene direktne rezervacije?
questions.answer: Da. Možete nastaviti da prihvatate sopstvene rezervacije. Najvažnije je da dostupnost ostane sinhronizovana, kako bi svaki potvrđeni boravak bio pravilno prikazan u kalendaru nekretnine i kako bi se izbegle preklapajuće rezervacije.

questions.question: Kako poboljšavate vidljivost moje nekretnine na platformama za rezervacije?
questions.answer: Fokusiramo se na elemente koji utiču na sposobnost nekretnine da bude konkurentna na internetu, uključujući kvalitet oglasa, cene, dostupnost, uslove rezervacije, informacije o nekretnini i ukupne performanse. Ovi elementi se kontinuirano analiziraju, umesto da se podese samo jednom i zatim ostave nepromenjeni.

questions.question: Na kojim platformama za rezervacije moja nekretnina može biti dostupna?
questions.answer: Strategija distribucije zavisi od nekretnine i profila gostiju koje želite da privučete. HostMetric može da upravlja i koordinira oglasima na vodećim relevantnim kanalima za rezervacije, uz održavanje dosledne dostupnosti i komercijalne strategije nekretnine.

questions.question: Kako se upravlja mojim rezervacijama i kalendarima?
questions.answer: HostMetric koordinira rezervacije i dostupnost kroz centralizovan proces upravljanja. Promene u kalendaru se sinhronizuju između povezanih kanala, što pomaže da dostupnost ostane tačna i smanjuje rizik od konfliktnih rezervacija.

questions.question: Ko komunicira sa mojim gostima?
questions.answer: HostMetric može da upravlja komunikacijom sa gostima tokom celog procesa rezervacije, pomažući da gosti dobiju jasne i pravovremene informacije pre dolaska, tokom boravka i prilikom odlaska, uz profesionalno i dosledno iskustvo.

questions.question: Ko određuje cenu noćenja moje nekretnine?
questions.answer: HostMetric upravlja prodajnom cenom nekretnine i kontinuirano je optimizuje. Vlasnik određuje minimalnu cenu noćenja koju je spreman da prihvati, dok naša strategija određivanja cena može primeniti više cene kada potražnja, tržišni uslovi i performanse nekretnine to opravdavaju.

questions.question: Kako funkcioniše dinamičko određivanje cena u HostMetric-u?
questions.answer: Cene se kontinuirano procenjuju na osnovu više pokazatelja, umesto da se oslanjamo na jednu fiksnu cenu noćenja. Uzimamo u obzir faktore kao što su potražnja, sezonalnost, ponašanje pri rezervisanju, dostupnost, tržišni uslovi i performanse same nekretnine kako bismo odredili konkurentniju prodajnu cenu.

questions.question: Mogu li da postavim minimalnu cenu noćenja?
questions.answer: Da. Možete odrediti minimalnu cenu noćenja koju ste spremni da prihvatite. Ovaj iznos predstavlja donju granicu naše strategije određivanja cena, a ne standardnu prodajnu cenu nekretnine. HostMetric može primeniti više cene kad god tržišni uslovi to podržavaju.

questions.question: Kako koristite AI i podatke za optimizaciju performansi moje nekretnine?
questions.answer: HostMetric koristi AI, algoritme za određivanje cena i podatke o performansama nekretnine kako bi podržao bolje komercijalne odluke. Kontinuirano analiziramo potražnju, ponašanje pri rezervisanju, sezonalnost, tržišne uslove i performanse same nekretnine kako bismo prepoznali prilike i vremenom optimizovali strategiju.

partnershipSection.title: Saradnja sa HostMetric-om
partnershipSection.description: Sve što treba da znate o isplatama, kontroli, naknadama za upravljanje i odnosu između vas i HostMetric-a.

questions.question: Šta se dešava ako već imam buduće rezervacije?
questions.answer: Postojeće potvrđene rezervacije mogu se uzeti u obzir tokom procesa uključivanja. Pregledaćemo trenutni kalendar i dostupnost nekretnine kako bismo organizovali prelazak na HostMetric upravljanje uz poštovanje rezervacija koje su već napravljene.

questions.question: Kako dobijam novac od svojih rezervacija?
questions.answer: Isplate rezervacija nastavljaju da prate proces odgovarajućeg kanala za rezervacije ili dogovorenu postavku. Uloga HostMetric-a je da upravlja nekretninom i optimizuje je; prihod od rezervacija ne mora da prolazi kroz HostMetric samo zato što upravljamo vašom nekretninom.

questions.question: Kako pomažete da se poboljšaju recenzije i ocene gostiju?
questions.answer: Dobre recenzije najčešće proizlaze iz dosledno pozitivnog iskustva gostiju. Fokusiramo se na tačne informacije u oglasu, jasnu komunikaciju, organizovano upravljanje rezervacijama i efikasnu podršku gostima, dok istovremeno pratimo povratne informacije kako bismo prepoznali ponavljajuće probleme i mogućnosti za poboljšanje.

questions.question: Kojim vrstama nekretnina i na kojim lokacijama HostMetric može da upravlja?
questions.answer: Svaka nekretnina se procenjuje pojedinačno. Razmatramo lokaciju, tip nekretnine, stanje, potencijal za kratkoročno izdavanje i operativne zahteve pre nego što utvrdimo da li je HostMetric odgovarajući partner za upravljanje.

questions.question: Postoje li početni troškovi ili mesečne pretplate?
questions.answer: HostMetric ne naplaćuje fiksnu mesečnu pretplatu za uslugu Kompletnog upravljanja. Naš model je zasnovan na performansama nekretnine, a ne na redovnoj softverskoj pretplati.

questions.question: Koliko košta HostMetric usluga upravljanja?
questions.answer: HostMetric usluga Kompletnog upravljanja naplaćuje se kroz procentualnu naknadu za upravljanje koja se obračunava na prihod od rezervacija. Naša standardna naknada za upravljanje iznosi 11%, dok se eventualno primenjivi PDV obračunava odvojeno. Na taj način naši interesi ostaju direktno usklađeni sa performansama vaše nekretnine.

questions.question: Da li i dalje imam kontrolu nad svojom nekretninom i dostupnošću?
questions.answer: Da. Nekretnina ostaje vaša. Možete nas obavestiti kada određeni datumi treba da budu nedostupni zbog lične upotrebe ili drugih razloga, a ta ograničenja mogu biti uneta u dostupnost dok HostMetric upravlja komercijalnom strategijom za preostale datume.

questions.question: Koliko traje partnerstvo?
questions.answer: Uslovi svakog partnerstva jasno se dogovaraju pre početka upravljanja. Naš cilj je da gradimo dugoročne odnose pružanjem kontinuirane vrednosti kroz profesionalno upravljanje, komunikaciju i performanse nekretnine.

questions.question: Šta se dešava ako odlučim da prekinem partnerstvo sa HostMetric-om?
questions.answer: Ako odlučite da prekinete partnerstvo, tranzicija se vodi u skladu sa dogovorenim uslovima, uzimajući u obzir postojeće rezervacije i obaveze prema gostima. Cilj je da proces ostane organizovan i za vlasnika i za goste sa potvrđenim boravcima.

continuousImprovement.title: Communication becomes operational data
continuousImprovement.description: Response times, repeated guest questions, issue categories and review themes can reveal friction points across the guest journey. These insights can then improve instructions, communication templates and property operations over time.

bookingManagementPage.description: Reservations, availability, calendars and booking restrictions are managed as one connected system across supported distribution channels.

calendarSynchronization.title: Calendar Synchronization
calendarSynchronization.description: Availability is coordinated across connected booking channels so that reservation changes can be reflected across the distribution strategy.

availabilityManagement.title: Availability Management
availabilityManagement.description: Available nights are monitored as perishable inventory: once an unsold night passes, its revenue opportunity cannot be recovered.

lengthOfStayControls.title: Length-of-Stay Controls
lengthOfStayControls.description: Minimum-stay rules can be adjusted strategically around high-demand periods while avoiding unnecessary restrictions that create unusable gaps in the calendar.

gapNightManagement.title: Gap-Night Management
gapNightManagement.description: Orphan nights and short availability gaps can be identified and managed so that booking rules do not unnecessarily prevent otherwise valuable reservations.

bookingPace.title: Booking Pace
bookingPace.description: Pickup patterns indicate how quickly future inventory is being consumed. Comparing booking pace across equivalent periods provides useful information for pricing and availability decisions.

multiChannelCoordination.title: Multi-Channel Coordination
multiChannelCoordination.description: Reservations from supported channels form part of a single commercial view of the property rather than being treated as unrelated platform activity.

connectedStrategy.title: Calendar decisions affect revenue decisions
connectedStrategy.description: Pricing and availability cannot be optimized independently. Booking pace, remaining inventory, length-of-stay restrictions and time until arrival all influence how valuable each remaining night may be.

greaterVisibilityPage.title: Visibility driven by distribution intelligence
greaterVisibilityPage.description: Strong distribution is not simply about appearing on more platforms. It is about understanding where demand originates, how each channel converts and what each booking contributes to commercial performance.

channelPerformance.title: Channel Performance
channelPerformance.description: We evaluate channel contribution using booking volume, booking value, acquisition cost, commission exposure and net revenue rather than relying on gross booking totals alone.

netRevenueAnalysis.title: Net Revenue Analysis
netRevenueAnalysis.description: Net Revenue = Gross Rental Revenue − Channel Costs. Comparing channels on a net basis gives a more meaningful picture of their economic value.

demandPositioning.title: Demand Positioning
demandPositioning.description: Search visibility, market demand, seasonality, local events and competitive positioning all influence where inventory should be exposed and at what price.

professionalRevenueLogic.title: Professional Revenue Logic
professionalRevenueLogic.description: Our methodology follows hospitality-grade revenue management principles built around the same core demand signals and commercial KPIs used across professional accommodation revenue teams.

centralizedManagementPage.title: One coordinated commercial view of your property
centralizedManagementPage.description: Pricing, availability, reservations and guest activity are most valuable when they are analysed together instead of as isolated pieces of information.

occupancyRate.title: Occupancy Rate
occupancyRate.description: Occupancy Rate = Booked Nights ÷ Available Nights × 100. We evaluate occupancy alongside rate performance rather than treating maximum occupancy as the objective.

bookingWindow.title: Booking Window
bookingWindow.description: Lead time measures the number of days between reservation and arrival. Changes in booking window can provide useful signals about demand behaviour and pricing conditions.

bookingPace.title: Booking Pace
bookingPace.description: Booking pace measures how quickly future inventory is being reserved relative to a historical baseline or commercial target, helping identify whether demand is building ahead of or behind expectations.

calendarEfficiency.title: Calendar Efficiency
calendarEfficiency.description: Minimum-stay rules, orphan nights and availability gaps are reviewed as part of the calendar strategy so that valuable inventory is not unnecessarily constrained.

smarterDistributionPage.title: Revenue decisions built around measurable demand
smarterDistributionPage.description: Our pricing approach analyses the relationship between rate, occupancy, booking pace, seasonality and market positioning rather than optimizing a single metric in isolation.

adr.title: ADR
adr.description: Average Daily Rate measures the average revenue generated by each occupied night: ADR = Rental Revenue ÷ Occupied Nights.

revpan.title: RevPAN
revpan.description: Revenue Per Available Night combines pricing and occupancy: RevPAN = Rental Revenue ÷ Available Nights. This makes it especially useful for short-term rentals.

priceElasticity.title: Price Elasticity
priceElasticity.description: Price elasticity describes how strongly booking demand responds to changes in price. Understanding that relationship helps avoid both unnecessary discounting and unrealistic pricing.

competitivePositioning.title: Competitive Positioning
competitivePositioning.description: Comparable properties, demand conditions, booking pace, events and seasonal patterns provide context for rate decisions instead of relying on a fixed nightly price.

hero.title: Politika privatnosti
hero.description: This Privacy Policy explains how HostMetric collects, uses, protects and manages personal information when you visit our website, contact us, submit a property or use our services.

whoWeAre.title: 1. Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: HostMetric provides services relating to short-term rental management, booking management, guest communication, distribution, listing optimization, pricing and property performance.

informationCollected.title: 2. Information We May Collect
informationCollected.description: The information collected depends on how you interact with HostMetric and which services you request.
items: Full name and contact details.
Email address and telephone number.
Country, postal address and business address.
Owner, authorized representative or business information.
Tax, registration or licensing information where required for property onboarding.
Property address, type, capacity, facilities and amenities.
Accommodation unit, room and bed configuration.
Existing Booking.com, Airbnb or other platform information.
Listing URLs, property IDs and channel-management details.
Pricing, occupancy, booking and performance information.
Guest policies, check-in information and operating details.
Messages and enquiries sent to HostMetric.
Technical information such as device, browser, IP and website usage information where applicable.

propertyPhotos.title: 3. Property Photos and Files
propertyPhotos.paragraph1: During property onboarding you may provide photographs, floor plans, documents and other material relating to your accommodation.
propertyPhotos.paragraph2: These files may be used to review the property, organize galleries, prepare listing content and, where agreed with you, configure or improve listings on accommodation platforms.
propertyPhotos.paragraph3: You should only upload files that you own or are legally authorized to provide and use.

collection.title: 4. How Information Is Collected
collection.description: Information may be collected when you:
items: Complete our Get Started onboarding form.
Submit a contact form.
Contact us by email or telephone.
Enter into discussions or an agreement with HostMetric.
Provide property information or files directly to us.
Use our website, where technical information may be collected through essential technologies or permitted cookies.

processing.title: 5. Why We Process Information
processing.description: Information may be processed for purposes including:
items: Responding to enquiries.
Reviewing prospective properties.
Creating and maintaining onboarding records.
Preparing listing, pricing and distribution strategies.
Configuring accommodation on booking platforms where agreed.
Managing reservations and guest communication.
Providing contracted HostMetric services.
Measuring and improving property and listing performance.
Maintaining accounting, administrative and business records.
Protecting the security of our services.
Meeting applicable legal obligations.

legalBases.title: 6. Legal Bases for Processing
legalBases.paragraph1: Depending on the circumstances, processing may be necessary to take steps at your request before entering into an agreement, to perform an agreement, to comply with legal obligations, to pursue legitimate business interests or, where required, on the basis of your consent.
legalBases.paragraph2: Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw that consent subject to applicable law.

platforms.title: 7. Booking Platforms and Service Providers
platforms.paragraph1: Where necessary to provide agreed services, information may be processed through third-party accommodation, technology, hosting, storage, email, analytics, payment or communication services.
platforms.paragraph2: Accommodation platforms such as Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo, Expedia and similar services operate under their own terms and privacy policies.
platforms.noSale: HostMetric does not sell personal information.

transfers.title: 8. International Data Transfers
transfers.paragraph1: Some technology providers may process data in countries outside your country of residence or outside the European Economic Area.
transfers.paragraph2: Where required by applicable data-protection law, appropriate transfer mechanisms or safeguards will be used.

retention.title: 9. Data Retention
retention.paragraph1: Personal information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, the management of our relationship with you, applicable accounting requirements and other legal or contractual obligations.
retention.paragraph2: When information is no longer required, it may be securely deleted or anonymized.

security.title: 10. Data Security
security.paragraph1: HostMetric uses reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss or destruction.
security.paragraph2: Access to information should be limited to persons and service providers who require it for legitimate business purposes.

rights.title: 11. Your Data Protection Rights
rights.description: Subject to applicable law, you may have rights including:
items: Access to your personal information.
Correction of inaccurate information.
Erasure in appropriate circumstances.
Restriction of processing.
Data portability where applicable.
Objection to certain processing.
Withdrawal of consent where processing relies on consent.
The right to complain to the relevant data protection supervisory authority.

cookies.title: 12. Cookies
cookies.paragraph1: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies for essential functionality, preferences, security and, where permitted, analytics or other optional purposes.
cookies.paragraph2BeforeLink: For more information, please read our

externalWebsites.title: 13. External Websites
externalWebsites.description: Our website may include links to external websites and booking platforms. HostMetric does not control the privacy practices, security or content of independent third-party websites.

changes.title: 14. Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.description: HostMetric may update this Privacy Policy when our services, technology, processing activities or legal obligations change. The current version will always be available on this page.

contact.title: 15. Contact
contact.description: For privacy questions or requests concerning your personal information, contact:

hero.title: Uslovi korišćenja
hero.description: These terms govern access to the HostMetric website, use of its online features and information submitted through our contact and property onboarding systems.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of These Terms
acceptance.paragraph1: By accessing or using the HostMetric website, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with them, you should discontinue use of the website.

about.title: 2. About HostMetric
about.paragraph1: HostMetric provides services relating to short-term rental management, booking management, guest communication, distribution, listing optimization, pricing and performance improvement.
about.paragraph2: The exact scope, fees, responsibilities and commercial terms for services provided to an individual client may be governed by a separate written agreement.

websiteInformation.title: 3. Website Information
websiteInformation.paragraph1: We aim to keep the content of this website clear, accurate and useful. However, hospitality markets, booking platforms, regulations, technology and commercial conditions may change.
websiteInformation.paragraph2: Website content is provided for general informational and commercial purposes and should not be considered a guarantee of a particular result.

caseStudies.title: 4. Property Performance and Case Studies
caseStudies.paragraph1: Revenue, occupancy, ratings, reviews, awards and other performance information displayed on the website relate to the individual property and measured period identified.
caseStudies.paragraph2: Past performance does not guarantee future results. Performance may vary because of location, property type, market demand, competition, seasonality, availability, pricing, platform algorithms, reviews and other factors.

pricingRevenue.title: 5. Pricing and Revenue Management
pricingRevenue.paragraph1: Pricing strategies may take into account historical booking information, comparable properties, market conditions, booking pace, availability, seasonality and other commercial indicators.
pricingRevenue.paragraph2: Pricing recommendations or changes cannot guarantee a particular level of revenue, profitability or occupancy.

onboarding.title: 6. Property Onboarding
onboarding.paragraph1: Completing a HostMetric Get Started or property onboarding form allows us to review information relating to a property.
onboarding.paragraph2: Submitting a form does not automatically create a management agreement, guarantee acceptance of the property or cause a listing to be published.
onboarding.paragraph3: HostMetric may contact the owner or authorized representative to verify or obtain additional information before services begin.

userInformation.title: 7. Information Provided by Users
userInformation.paragraph1: You are responsible for ensuring that information provided through our website is accurate to the best of your knowledge.
userInformation.paragraph2: You must not knowingly submit false, misleading, unlawful or unauthorized information.

materials.title: 8. Photographs, Documents and Other Material
materials.paragraph1: By submitting photographs, floor plans, documents or other material, you confirm that you own the material or have sufficient permission to provide and use it for the purposes requested.
materials.paragraph2: Where agreed as part of our services, such materials may be prepared, organized or used in accommodation listings.

thirdPartyPlatforms.title: 9. Third-Party Platforms
thirdPartyPlatforms.paragraph1: Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo, Expedia and other accommodation or technology providers are independent third parties.
thirdPartyPlatforms.paragraph2: Their fees, policies, terms, systems, rankings, algorithms and availability may change independently of HostMetric.

intellectualProperty.title: 10. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.paragraph1: Unless otherwise stated, original HostMetric branding, website copy, designs, graphics, software and other HostMetric-created materials are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws.
intellectualProperty.paragraph2: They may not be reproduced, republished, distributed, commercially exploited or materially modified without permission.
intellectualProperty.paragraph3: Third-party names, logos and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.

acceptableUse.title: 11. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.description: You must not use the website to:
items: Attempt unauthorized access to systems or data.
Upload malware or malicious material.
Interfere with normal website operation.
Submit fraudulent or misleading information.
Violate applicable law or third-party rights.

availabilityLiability.title: 12. Website Availability and Liability
availabilityLiability.paragraph1: We take reasonable steps to maintain the website and the accuracy of its content, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation at all times.
availabilityLiability.paragraph2: To the extent permitted by applicable law, HostMetric will not be responsible for indirect or consequential loss caused solely by reliance on general website information or by circumstances outside our reasonable control.
availabilityLiability.paragraph3: Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability where exclusion or limitation would be unlawful.

externalLinks.title: 13. External Links
externalLinks.paragraph1: Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience or functionality. HostMetric is not responsible for the content, availability, security or practices of independent third-party websites.

privacy.paragraphBeforeLink: Personal information is handled in accordance with our

changes.paragraph2: The latest version will be available on this page.

hero.title: Politika kolačića
hero.description: This policy explains how HostMetric may use cookies and similar technologies and how you can control optional technologies when using our website.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.paragraph1: Cookies are small data files that may be stored on your computer, phone or other device when you visit a website.
whatAreCookies.paragraph2: They can help websites operate correctly, remember settings, maintain sessions, improve security and, where permitted, understand how visitors use a website.

similarTechnologies.title: 2. Similar Technologies
similarTechnologies.paragraph1: Websites may also use related technologies such as local storage, pixels, tags or similar technical tools. References to cookies in this policy may include these technologies where appropriate.

necessaryCookies.title: 3. Strictly Necessary Cookies
necessaryCookies.paragraph1: These technologies are required for essential website functionality or for a service specifically requested by the user.
necessaryCookies.paragraph2: They may support functions such as security, navigation, form operation, session management and other essential technical features.
necessaryCookies.notice: Essential cookies cannot always be disabled through a website preference tool because the website may require them to provide the requested functionality.

preferenceCookies.title: 4. Preference Cookies
preferenceCookies.paragraph1: Preference cookies may remember choices you make, such as language, display settings or other website preferences.

analyticsCookies.title: 5. Analytics Cookies
analyticsCookies.paragraph1: Analytics technologies may be used to understand how visitors interact with the website, which pages are used most often and how website performance can be improved.
analyticsCookies.paragraph2: Where consent is legally required, these technologies will only be activated after the relevant permission has been obtained.

marketingCookies.title: 6. Marketing and Advertising Cookies
marketingCookies.paragraph1: Marketing technologies may be used to measure advertising campaigns, understand marketing effectiveness or provide more relevant advertising.
marketingCookies.paragraph2: They are treated as optional and will not be activated before consent where consent is required by applicable law.

sessionPersistentCookies.title: 7. Session and Persistent Cookies
sessionPersistentCookies.paragraph1: Cookies may also be classified according to how long they remain on your device.
sessionPersistentCookies.sessionText: generally expire when the browser session ends.
sessionPersistentCookies.persistentText: remain for a defined period or until removed.

thirdPartyServices.title: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.paragraph1: Certain functions may be provided by third-party services, such as analytics, maps, embedded content, social-media features or other technology providers.
thirdPartyServices.paragraph2: These providers may use their own cookies or similar technologies in accordance with their own privacy and cookie policies.

cookieChoices.title: 9. Your Cookie Choices
cookieChoices.paragraph1: Where optional cookies are used, visitors will be provided with a mechanism to make appropriate choices before those optional technologies are enabled when legally required.
cookieChoices.paragraph2: You may also control or remove cookies through your browser settings. Blocking certain technologies may affect some website functionality.

consent.title: 10. Changing or Withdrawing Consent
consent.paragraph1: Where processing relies on cookie consent, you may change or withdraw your preferences through the available cookie settings mechanism.
consent.paragraph2: Withdrawal of consent will not affect processing that was lawful before withdrawal.

updates.title: 11. Updates to This Policy
updates.paragraph1: This Cookie Policy may be updated when technologies, providers, website features or applicable requirements change.
updates.paragraph2: The current version will always be published on this page.
